title: Welcome!
text:
About the Blog
Joey Ran the Stats is a blog about the beautiful game of baseball and the numbers behind it.
I’m Joey, a freshman at Northwestern studying math, and I’m starting this to get more practice working with real baseball data and to write about anything interesting I find.
I hope to publish at least once a month. As a full-time college student, the schedule might not always be consistent, but I’ll share new work whenever I can.

title: Welcome!
text:
What to Expect
You can expect to find a mix of:

Baseball analytics and player evaluation
New statistical models and data visualizations
Intriguing findings from real baseball data
Select projects from the Northwestern Student R&D Team

Follow Along
The code for everything I write will be available on GitHub, so you can explore the models and reproduce my results yourself.
More to come soon. Stay tuned!

title: About
text:
Hi, I’m Joey! I’m a freshman at Northwestern studying Applied Math and Mathematical Methods in the Social Sciences (MMSS).
I’m on the Student R&D Team for Northwestern Baseball, and I’m a lifelong Cubs fan. I’m just getting formally started in baseball analytics, and this blog is how I plan to practice in public.
All my code is on GitHub, so you can check my work :)
